description: Shared Renovate policy for alunduil's repositories.

packageRules.description: These update types carry no release timestamp, so the release-age wait would hold them forever without opening a PR
Pin dev container images, which docker:pinDigests leaves unpinned because the dev container CLI rejects tag@digest on features
mise lock writes these files and mise.lock records their digest, so only the mise manager can change them without breaking locked installs
A release job runs these beside the credential it publishes with. Runner images are exempt because GitHub also issues that job's OIDC token. automerge-workflow-majors repeats this rule; change both.
